title: ModelDescriptor
description: A small JSON file, itself an entry of a signed manifest (kind model, mediaType application/vnd.airplanemode.model+json, at most 65536 bytes), that lists the other manifest entries an engine needs (weights, tokenizer, configs, WASM runtime or model library) and how to run them. Never carries a URL; nothing in it is fetched. Files MUST be sorted by path in byte order with unique paths and devices MUST be sorted; modelLib and runtimeWasm MUST each equal one of the files[].path; generation.chatTemplateKwargs MUST NOT use the keys __proto__, constructor or prototype (all verified outside JSON Schema by validateModelDescriptor / the descriptor loader). Wire formats accepted: airplanemode.model/0.1 and airplanemode.model/0.2; writers emit 0.2.

spec.description: Wire-format discriminator (major.minor). Consumers accept exactly these two values and reject any other (reason bad_spec). Writers emit airplanemode.model/0.2.

id.description: Logical model id. Two descriptors (for example one per device) may share it; the manifest entry id is what keys files in the runtime.

engine.description: transformers-js (devices wasm and/or webgpu) or webllm (devices exactly ['webgpu']).

devices.description: Execution devices this descriptor supports, unique and sorted ('wasm' before 'webgpu').

dtype.description: Quantisation label, for example q4, q8 or q4f16.

files.description: Sorted by path in byte order; paths unique (verified outside JSON Schema).

runtimeWasm.description: Path, listed in files, of the engine's WASM runtime. Required for transformers-js and absent (type null) for webllm; the entry behind it has kind wasm.

modelLib.description: Path, listed in files, of the compiled model library. Required for webllm and absent (type null) for transformers-js; the entry behind it has kind wasm.

chatTemplateKwargs.description: Extra variables for the chat template, for example enable_thinking false for Qwen3. Keys match the canonical key pattern but are never __proto__, constructor or prototype (rejected outside JSON Schema, reason invalid_key); values are strings, integers or booleans.

sessionOptions.description: 0.2 and transformers-js only (absent for webllm and for wire string 0.1). Reaches ONNX Runtime session_options as a fresh object literal built from the validated fields.

source.description: Provenance only: never fetched, never trusted.

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the model weights.

anyOf.description: A: transformers-js, wire 0.2: runtimeWasm required, modelLib absent.
B: transformers-js, wire 0.1: runtimeWasm required, modelLib and sessionOptions absent.
C: webllm: devices exactly ['webgpu'], modelLib required, runtimeWasm and sessionOptions absent.

Path.description: Relative path, '/'-separated, no leading dot, no '..', no empty segment, no backslash.

entryId.description: Id of a manifest entry of the same manifest as the descriptor.
